summary_en: Mitsubishi Electric authorized acquisition of up to 80 million shares (3.91% of outstanding shares) for a maximum of 20.0 billion yen via on-market purchase from November 1, 2026 to March 31, 2027. The company also resolved to cancel 23 million existing treasury shares (1.09% of pre-cancellation outstanding shares) on November 30, 2026.
title_en: Notice Regarding Decisions on Matters Related to Acquisition of Treasury Stock and Cancellation of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
On October 30, 2026, Mitsubishi Electric's Board of Directors authorized the acquisition of its own shares under Article 459(1) of the Companies Act and the company's articles of incorporation. The authorization permits acquisition of up to 80 million ordinary shares for a maximum aggregate amount of 20.0 billion yen. The acquisition will be conducted via on-market purchase on the Tokyo Stock Exchange between November 1, 2026 and March 31, 2027. Based on outstanding shares (excluding treasury stock) of 2,046,880,069 shares as of September 30, 2026, this represents 3.91% of outstanding shares.

The company stated the acquisition is part of its capital allocation policy, aimed at strengthening shareholder returns and improving capital efficiency. Market conditions may result in partial or no execution of the authorized acquisition.

Simultaneously, the Executive Officers resolved to cancel 23 million treasury shares held by the company, representing 1.09% of outstanding shares prior to cancellation, effective November 30, 2026. As of September 30, 2026, the company held 66,321,482 treasury shares, including shares held in trust accounts for the Board Incentive Plan (1,107,827 shares) and Employee Stock Ownership Plan (259,500 shares).
